# montecarlo_databricks_sql_warehouse_credentials (Data Source)

Databricks SQL warehouse credentials are a token or OAuth client Monte Carlo stores to run queries on a SQL warehouse. The token or OAuth secret is never returned.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `credentials_id` (String) Id of the credentials, as returned when they are created or listed.

### Read-Only

- `azure_tenant_id` (String) Microsoft Entra ID tenant of the service principal. Null unless set.
- `azure_workspace_resource_id` (String) Azure resource ID of the workspace. Null unless set.
- `connection_type` (String) The connection type the credentials are for, such as `snowflake`. Fixed once created.
- `created_time` (String) When the credentials were created.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the credentials.
- `oauth_client_id` (String) Client ID of the OAuth service principal. Null for token credentials.
- `sql_warehouse_id` (String) ID of the Databricks SQL warehouse the connection runs on.
- `storage_type` (String) Where the secret lives. Fixed once created.
- `workspace_id` (String) ID of the Databricks workspace. Null unless set.
- `workspace_url` (String) URL of the Databricks workspace, or its host name.
